lead.en: Build and test a short host-driven automation with a branch.
lead.zh: 创建并测试由宿主驱动、包含分支的短工作流。

rule.en: The host executes steps and resolves matching request IDs. Stop emits Cancel and rejects late responses; Retry resumes the failed step. Branch results must reference a supplied path. The example is simulated and sends nothing. The preview offers Passes, Fails, Loading and Empty scenarios; it sends nothing.
rule.zh: 步骤由宿主执行，并按请求 ID 返回结果；停止会发出取消事件并忽略迟到的响应，重试从失败步骤继续。分支结果必须引用已提供的路径。示例为模拟，不发送任何内容。 预览可切换成功、失败、运行中和空状态，不会发送数据。

api.en: Subscribe to RunStep (which contains Box<WorkflowStep>) and Cancel; call resolve with an output, duration and branch path when applicable. Changed reports editor updates. Provide stable unique step and path IDs.
api.zh: 订阅 RunStep（包含 Box<WorkflowStep>） 与 Cancel，通过 resolve 提供输出、耗时及分支路径；编辑时发出 Changed。步骤和分支须使用稳定且唯一的 ID。

motion.en: A 200 ms connector fill and marker indicate the active step; reduced motion shows the end state and hidden previews do not request animation frames. Path crossfades, measured-height expansion and searchable command menu remain unimplemented. Desktop, Web, screen-reader and visual acceptance are pending.
motion.zh: 运行步骤的连线和标记以 200ms 填充；减少动效时直接显示终态，隐藏预览时不请求动画帧。分支淡入淡出、高度过渡和可搜索菜单仍未实现；桌面、网页、读屏与视觉验收待完成。
